reason: The Filters panel is a vertical tablist: Tab stops on the selected tab and ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move between tabs, so the Status tab and its panel are reachable by keyboard. The focus probe reached the tab only by direct focus, so I tested by keyboard: Tab, Tab, End, ArrowUp, ArrowUp from a freshly opened panel selects Status and shows its panel (shot). The overlay's real trigger, the Filters (3) button, is a Tab stop in the sweep's own trace. Separate from this claim: arrowing onto a tab whose panel has a search field moves focus into the panel, and after Category it took more than 39 Shift+Tab presses to get back to the tab list.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 Keyboard passes: the Filters panel is a vertical tablist (role tablist, aria-orientation vertical) with a roving tabindex. Tab stops on the selected tab only, and ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move between tabs and select them, as in the APG tabs pattern, so the Status tab and its panel are operable without a mouse. 4.1.2 passes: each tab exposes role tab, its name, aria-selected and aria-controls. 2.1.2 passes: Tab leaves the panel, the focus probe's walk ended with end: exit. Arrowing onto a tab whose panel has a search field moves focus into that field (a possible 2.4.3 or 3.2.2 issue). That is a different failure from the one claimed here, so I did not rate it.
